::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
Founded 2022; headquartered in New Delhi with a design centre in Noida. Licenses network-on-chip, crossbar and related interconnect IP, with distributors abroad.
:::

## What does this firm design?

NoC and crossbar interconnect IP for SoCs.
